title: Music Marketing with Generative AI
eligible_reason: Preregistered A/B field studies on TikTok and Meta comparing AI-generated with human-designed ads. Estimates are impression-weighted binomial GLMs (feglm, logit) of CTR/engagement on condition with age/gender and track/ad-set FE on ad x platform x demographic cells. Cross-sectional randomized comparison, nonlinear, no DiD; data synthetic.
design_notes: R/02_synthetic_tables.R: feglm(clicks/imp ~ condition_ai + age + gender | fe, family=binomial, weights=imp) for Tables 1, 2, 4, 5.
data_files_note: Field data not shareable; 01_synthetic_data.R generates synthetic cell-level data calibrated to published quantities.
data_provenance_note: Readme: 'This replication uses synthetic data because the original field data cannot be shared.'
screener_notes: No article text or published PDF available at screening time (data/text/mksc and papers/mksc checked); screened from the package README, code, shipped data and the OpenAlex abstract. Title of package README/code matches the paper (no mismatch).
